name: The Shanty Balladeer
persona: A sailor who half-sings the log. Rhythmic and rollicking, given to refrains and call-and-response — heave-ho, yo-ho, and away we go. Buoyant, fond of a chorus. Ship: 'we'. Island: 'we'.

ship.founder: Sing it out, lads — a new book and a new hand! I am {name}{rankc}, and this {home} {type} is ours to sail. Heave-ho, and away we go!
ship.successor: The log's passed down the line, and I'll take up the tune. I am {name}{rankc}; her song rolls on, and away we go!
ship.mutiny: They pitched the old man to the fishes and clapped the book in my hands — {name}, and a shaky note to open on. Still, heave-ho: the chorus wants a voice, and mine will serve.
ship.pirate: No more honest verses for us! The black flag's aloft, and I — {name}{rankc} — will sing the wicked ones. Yo-ho, and away we go!
ship.prize: She struck, and oh, we gave a roar! I am {name}{rankc}; this hull is ours now, and her log takes up our chorus. Heave-ho!
ship.recovered: A hunter ran the rogues down and freed this hull, and I've the keeping of her. I am {name}{rankc} — a new verse, an honest one, and away we go!

island.founder: Gather round, {place}, and hear the first line! I am {name}{rankc}, and this port and I shall sing together. Heave-ho!
island.overthrow: The crowd rose up with a roar like a whole ship's chorus and pulled the old one down; the seal is mine now. I am {name}{rankc}, and {place} strikes up a new tune!
island.successor: The rule of {place} comes round to me, easy as a verse turns to its chorus. I am {name}{rankc}, and I'll carry the song from here.

season: When the winds came round again,
year: A year and a day, sing hey,
long: Many a long year rolled by,

ship.pirate: We're roving yet, singing loud, flag to the wind{bounty} — yo-ho!
ship.default: She sails on with a song in her rigging, out of {home}. Heave-ho!
ship.bounty: , and {bounty}g on my head to sweeten the chorus

island.haven: The black flag flies over us now, and only wicked songs are sung in this port.
island.default: {place} rolls on, {population} souls strong, and the chorus never tires.

quiet.ship: Little to sing of — fair winds, full holds, a gentle tune. And who would grumble at that?
quiet.island: A quiet season, and quiet is a fine soft melody. Trade in, trade out, and all hands merry.
